title: Shishov's Walk - Part I
prompt:
[Intro][Dark Ambient][Sub Bass Pulse][Vinyl Crackle][Industrial Drones][Underground Cathedral][Neon Flicker][TB-303 Acid Lines][Minimal Techno Foundation][Psychological Tension]
Yevgeny Shishov walked through the woods
Walked Shishov and found a mushroom

[Verse 1][Deep Kick][Analog Synth][Repetitive Hypnosis][Death In Vegas Style][Shadowy Atmosphere][Muffled Vocals][Tape Degradation]
Did Shishov walk?
Or found a mushroom?
Or walked through the woods Yevgeny Shishov
Was it really him, Yevgeny Shishov
Forgot how he walked through the woods
And found a mushroom?

[Build Up][Filter Sweeps][Rising Tension][Acid Sequences][Dark Energy Accumulation]
The mushroom asks, why did you walk?

[Drop][Full Arrangement][Warehouse Rave Intensity][Distorted Bass][Psychotic Energy][Underground Techno]
Won't tell — answered Shishov
Now that's a Show!
Shishov didn't know which mushroom he found
Today there will be a Show!

[Breakdown][Stripped Beats][Ethereal Voices][Memory Fragments][Cosmic Echoes]
Is he walking? Or walked?

[Build Up][Tension Rebuild][Industrial Percussion][Acid Returns]
Or will he walk Yevgeny Shishov?

[Final Drop][Maximum Intensity][Chaos Reigns][Eternal Groove][Distortion Peak]
Or maybe he walked through mountains
Wait, Yevgeny Shishov walked somewhere

[Outro][Fade Out][Tape Hiss][Sub Bass Decay][Silence Waits]
On the road he found something

gpt_description_prompt: Underground psychedelic techno in the style of Death in Vegas. Dark cathedral atmosphere with TB-303 acid lines, deep sub bass, vinyl crackle, industrial drones. Muffled vocals through tape degradation, repetitive hypnotic rhythms, warehouse rave energy. Neon noir aesthetic, psychological tension, shadowy and mysterious.
